notes.title: Edit a block beside the page
notes.text: On a tablet or a computer, tap a block or a picture to open its settings in a side panel. You’ll find Remove in the panel.

notes.title: Add with a round button
notes.text: The button that creates something new in lists, Files and Redirects is now a round button that floats above the page. If a list has several kinds, it opens a menu of them.
An H1 now starts a section with its own color, like an H2
The side panel and the menu fit the screen better on a tablet
The text toolbar and the menus over the text are white with a shadow
On a wide screen, Preview and View on the website stand at the end of the page’s title row
The Appstore’s Installed filter lists every installed app
